title: Apache cleanup runners execute compiler output from predictable shared temporary trees
title_de: Apache-Cleanup-Runner führen Compiler-Ausgabe aus vorhersagbaren gemeinsam genutzten temporären Bäumen aus
security_invariant: A compiler-output directory used for immediate execution must be freshly created, private, non-symlinked, and bound to the invoking process; a lower-privileged local actor must not be able to preseed or replace its executable pathname.
security_invariant_de: Ein für unmittelbare Ausführung verwendetes Compiler-Output-Verzeichnis muss frisch erzeugt, privat, nicht verlinkt und an den aufrufenden Prozess gebunden sein; ein niedriger privilegierter lokaler Akteur darf seinen ausführbaren Pfad weder vorab erzeugen noch ersetzen können.
protocol: local/shared-host CI and test-runner filesystem execution boundary
profile: remediated exact Draft PR #183 RulesSet-cleanup runner plus identical unresolved current request-transaction cleanup sibling
trust_boundary: A lower-privileged local/shared-host filesystem actor can preseed or race a predictable directory under sticky /var/tmp before a developer or shared-runner process compiles and executes a fixed binary name. The validated boundary is local process identity, not an external pull request, GitHub token, secret, network, or connector-runtime boundary.
sink: The pre-remediation RulesSet runner preserves an existing output tree through mkdir -p, links a fixed apache-rules-set-cleanup binary in it, and immediately executes that pathname. The current request-transaction sibling has the same OUT/BUILD_ROOT, mkdir -p, fixed binary, and execution sequence.
summary: Retained security-diff evidence validates the pre-remediation Apache RulesSet-cleanup runner weakness: a predictable output tree below /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified/build can be preseeded or raced before fixed-name execution on a multi-user developer host or shared self-hosted runner. Exact Draft PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 remediates that task-introduced RulesSet instance with a private-output contract and negative controls; it is no longer a candidate-integration blocker. The identical pre-existing request-transaction cleanup runner remains on Parent master, so the canonical finding stays in_progress for that sibling only. GitHub external-PR/token escalation remains counterevidenced: no pull_request_target, untrusted workflow input, writable token, or PR path reaches either runner.
summary_de: Zurückgehaltene Security-Diff-Evidence validiert die Pre-Remediation-Schwäche des Apache-RulesSet-Cleanup-Runners: Ein vorhersagbarer Output-Baum unter /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified/build kann vor der Ausführung mit festem Namen auf einem Multi-User-Developer-Host oder Shared-Self-Hosted-Runner vorab erzeugt oder geraced werden. Der exakte Draft-PR-#183-Head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 repariert diese vom Task eingeführte RulesSet-Instanz mit einem Private-Output-Vertrag und Negative-Controls; sie ist kein Candidate-Integration-Blocker mehr. Der identische bereits bestehende Request-Transaction-Cleanup-Runner bleibt auf Parent-master, daher bleibt das kanonische Finding nur für diesen Sibling in_progress. GitHub-External-PR-/Token-Eskalation bleibt widerlegt: Kein pull_request_target, kein untrusted Workflow-Input, kein writable Token und kein PR-Pfad erreichen einen der Runner.
scope_disposition: The exact Draft PR #183 RulesSet-cleanup runner was remediated and validated on head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118, including private-output negative controls. This record no longer blocks that candidate. Its in_progress scope is limited to the semantically identical, pre-existing request-transaction cleanup runner on Parent master, which was not changed by #183.
observed_behavior: The retained pre-remediation candidate snapshot at ci/checks/connectors/apache/check-apache-rules-set-cleanup.sh:8,19-25,82-91 sets OUT from APACHE_RULES_SET_CLEANUP_OUT, BUILD_ROOT, or the deterministic /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified/build/apache-rules-set-cleanup default. Its only path control requires an absolute string. mkdir -p keeps a pre-existing tree, the compiler writes OUT/apache-rules-set-cleanup, and the script executes that pathname. Direct host evidence records /var/tmp as root:root mode 1777 and the predictable project/build parents as ordinary mode 755. The current Parent sibling check-apache-request-transaction-cleanup.sh has the same construction at lines 8,19-25,81-89.
observed_behavior_de: Der zurückgehaltene Pre-Remediation-Kandidaten-Snapshot bei ci/checks/connectors/apache/check-apache-rules-set-cleanup.sh:8,19-25,82-91 setzt OUT aus APACHE_RULES_SET_CLEANUP_OUT, BUILD_ROOT oder dem deterministischen Default /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified/build/apache-rules-set-cleanup. Seine einzige Pfadkontrolle verlangt einen absoluten String. mkdir -p behält einen vorbestehenden Baum, der Compiler schreibt OUT/apache-rules-set-cleanup und das Skript führt diesen Pfad aus. Direkte Host-Evidence erfasst /var/tmp als root:root mode 1777 und die vorhersagbaren Projekt-/Build-Parents als gewöhnliche mode-755-Verzeichnisse. Der aktuelle Parent-Sibling check-apache-request-transaction-cleanup.sh besitzt dieselbe Konstruktion bei Zeilen 8,19-25,81-89.
expected_behavior: Each Apache cleanup runner must create a fresh private mode-700 output directory beneath a validated temporary parent and compile/execute only inside that directory. An inherited OUT, BUILD_ROOT, predictable default, existing directory, symlink, or final-name replacement must not become authority over compiler output or execution. The normal APR compile/run interface must remain available in its isolated legitimate-control environment.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder Apache-Cleanup-Runner muss unter einem validierten temporären Parent ein frisches privates mode-700-Output-Verzeichnis erzeugen und nur darin kompilieren/ausführen. Ein geerbtes OUT, BUILD_ROOT, vorhersagbarer Default, bestehendes Verzeichnis, Symlink oder Final-Name-Replacement darf keine Autorität über Compiler-Ausgabe oder Ausführung erhalten. Die normale APR-Compile-/Run-Schnittstelle muss in ihrer isolierten Legitimate-Control-Umgebung verfügbar bleiben.
impact: A successful local race can cause one developer or shared-runner process to execute a substituted local binary under the victim identity, or redirect compiler output. The effect is potentially high for that process, but the vector is localhost and requires a multi-user/shared-host timing precondition; retained attack-path analysis calibrates severity as low/P3. The evidence establishes no public endpoint, remote exploit, GitHub PR or credential escalation, secret access, fleet-wide effect, connector request-processing impact, or normal hosted-CI attacker path.
impact_de: Ein erfolgreicher lokaler Race kann einen Developer- oder Shared-Runner-Prozess dazu bringen, eine ersetzte lokale Binary unter der Opferidentität auszuführen oder Compiler-Ausgabe umzuleiten. Der Effekt ist für diesen Prozess potenziell hoch, aber der Vektor ist localhost und benötigt eine Multi-User-/Shared-Host-Timing-Voraussetzung; die zurückgehaltene Attack-Path-Analyse kalibriert den Schweregrad als low/P3. Die Evidence belegt keinen öffentlichen Endpoint, keinen Remote-Exploit, keine GitHub-PR- oder Credential-Eskalation, keinen Secret-Zugriff, keinen Fleet-weiten Effekt, keinen Connector-Request-Processing-Impact und keinen normalen Hosted-CI-Angreiferpfad.
preconditions: A lower-privileged local actor shares a multi-user developer host or shared self-hosted runner with the invoking process and can create paths under /var/tmp.
The victim invokes the Apache cleanup target without a separately validated fresh private output directory, causing the predictable default or a controllable output root to be used.
The actor precreates or races the selected tree before or between compiler/linker output and the immediate execution of the fixed binary name.
The runner reaches its compiler/linker and execution path with its ordinary Apache/APXS/APR prerequisites available.
reproduction: Read the retained bounded validation and attack-path reports for the pre-remediation RulesSet runner snapshot at lines 8,19-25,82-91; together they establish the source, absolute-only control, filesystem precondition, linker output, execution sink, local/shared-host threat model, and GitHub PR/token counterevidence.
Confirm the host evidence recorded by the report: /var/tmp is mode 1777 root:root, while /var/tmp/ModSecurity-conector-verified and its build parent are ordinary mode-755 directories.
Inspect the current request-transaction sibling at lines 8,19-25,81-89; it has the same root selection, mkdir -p preservation, fixed binary name, and immediate execution structure.

Do not run a live cross-user race for this record task. It would require unsafe concurrent manipulation; the retained deterministic static path plus observed sticky ancestor establish the bounded local/shared-host precondition.

evidence.command: Retained bounded static source/configuration trace, direct host filesystem metadata, and task-owned runner control; no live cross-user race was executed.
evidence.result: Reportable local path-confinement weakness at medium confidence 0.72. It validates the predictable default, absolute-only control, mkdir/link/execute sink, mode-1777 ancestor, and separate GitHub PR/token counterevidence.

evidence.command: Retained repository threat-model and source/configuration attack-path trace for the candidate.
evidence.result: Reportable localhost path: a lower-privileged actor can precreate the deterministic tree and race the final pathname. Impact is high per successful race, likelihood is low, and the severity matrix yields low/P3.
Current Parent source has the matching default output-root, absolute-only control, mkdir -p, fixed binary, and immediate execution pattern at lines 8,19-25,81-89.

root_cause: The runner design treats an absolute output string as sufficient authority and reuses a deterministic directory under a sticky shared ancestor. mkdir -p does not establish ownership, freshness, permissions, non-symlink identity, or post-link binding. The compiler outputs a predictable binary name, then the script executes that name without preventing a local actor from preserving or replacing it. The existing request-transaction runner repeats the same root-control/control/sink arrangement.
root_cause_de: Das Runner-Design behandelt einen absoluten Output-String als ausreichende Autorität und verwendet ein deterministisches Verzeichnis unter einem sticky Shared-Ancestor wieder. mkdir -p etabliert weder Ownership, Frische, Berechtigungen, Non-Symlink-Identität noch eine Post-Link-Bindung. Der Compiler erzeugt einen vorhersagbaren Binary-Namen, danach führt das Skript diesen Namen aus, ohne einen lokalen Akteur am Erhalten oder Ersetzen zu hindern. Der bestehende Request-Transaction-Runner wiederholt dieselbe Root-Control-/Control-/Sink-Anordnung.
proposed_remediation: Repair the RulesSet and request-transaction cleanup runners together through one audited confinement contract: choose a validated temporary parent, create a fresh private mode-700 directory with mktemp -d, compile and execute only inside that directory, and reject or remove externally selected deterministic output-root authority. Add source-contract negative coverage for preseeded default/BUILD_ROOT, symlink, and final-name replacement attempts plus a legitimate APR compile/run control. Preserve compiler, APXS/APR, and Apache behavior; do not weaken workflow permissions, scanners, Quality Gates, or existing path controls.
proposed_remediation_de: RulesSet- und Request-Transaction-Cleanup-Runner gemeinsam über einen auditierten Confinement-Vertrag reparieren: Einen validierten temporären Parent wählen, mit mktemp -d ein frisches privates mode-700-Verzeichnis erzeugen, nur darin kompilieren und ausführen und extern gewählte deterministische Output-Root-Autorität zurückweisen oder entfernen. Source-Contract-Negativ-Coverage für vorab erzeugten Default/BUILD_ROOT, Symlink und Final-Name-Replacement sowie einen legitimen APR-Compile-/Run-Control ergänzen. Compiler-, APXS/APR- und Apache-Verhalten bewahren; Workflow-Berechtigungen, Scanner, Quality Gates oder bestehende Pfadkontrollen nicht abschwächen.
acceptance_criteria: Both Apache cleanup runners create a fresh private mode-700 output directory below a validated temporary parent before compiler output exists.
A preseeded deterministic default, inherited BUILD_ROOT/OUT, symlink, or final-name replacement cannot select or replace the executable that the runner invokes.
The RulesSet and request-transaction runners retain their legitimate Apache/APXS/APR compiler and harness execution behavior in an isolated task-owned environment.

Focused source-contract, negative containment, legitimate-control, shell syntax, and security-diff checks pass without weakening workflow permissions, scanner exclusions, Quality Gates, or production Apache behavior.
A fresh exact-head review and hosted checks exist before any fixed, verified, or closed disposition.
validation_plan: Run focused source-contract regressions proving both runners create and use a fresh private directory instead of an inherited deterministic output root.
Exercise preseeded default/BUILD_ROOT, symlink, and final-name-replacement negative controls without creating an unsafe live cross-user race.
Run the legitimate APR compile/run controls for both runners in a verified task-owned Apache/APXS/APR environment.
Run shell syntax, a focused security-diff review, and fresh exact-head hosted checks for the repaired candidate.
regression_tests: Focused static contract test for fresh private output-directory creation and no inherited deterministic OUT/BUILD_ROOT execution authority in both Apache cleanup runners.
Negative preseeded-root, symlink, and final-name-replacement controls.
Shell syntax check for each changed runner.
legitimate_control_tests: RulesSet cleanup harness compiles and runs successfully with verified Apache/APXS/APR prerequisites inside a fresh task-owned output directory.
Request-transaction cleanup harness compiles and runs successfully with the same private-output contract.
A normal hosted caller continues to use its job-local temporary root with read-only contents permissions.
dependencies: A task-owned Parent worktree for source remediation and isolated output roots.
Shell mktemp support and a validated temporary-parent contract.
Apache/APXS/APR/libmodsecurity prerequisites for the legitimate native harness controls.
Fresh exact-head hosted review and CI evidence after remediation.
